name: AsyncCondition
reason: The model captures the success and libuv-error outcomes but omits allocation, IO locking, handle association, failure cleanup, finalizer registration, and their source order.

name: AsyncCondition
reason: The model states the returned condition and pending-event scheduling decision but omits the callback task, cancellation shielding, wait loop, callback invocation, lifetime operations, locking, and scheduling calls.

name: Timer
reason: The model narrows Real seconds to integer microseconds and replaces allocation, both libuv calls, assertions, locking, and finalization with Boolean inputs, so the proposition does not cover all allowed durations or source outcomes.

name: getproperty
reason: The model supports only five fields, returns milliseconds and a handle Boolean, and omits division to seconds, cond, timeout_ms, interval_ms, arbitrary Symbol fallback, and getfield errors.

name: show
reason: The model prints millisecond values and omits the object address, hexadecimal conversion, padding, and exact seconds text, so its exact-string proposition is not the method's output.

name: unsafe_convert
reason: The model returns only a has-handle Boolean and therefore loses the exact pointer returned by t.handle.

name: unsafe_convert
reason: The model returns only a has-handle Boolean and therefore loses the exact pointer returned by async.handle.

name: _trywait
reason: The model omits the cancellation argument and resolve_cancel_token call and substitutes an immediate event-state result for the forwarded blocking method.

name: _trywait
reason: The model omits the token, atomic fences, rechecks, locking, preservation, wait loop, wakeup handling, cleanup, and reset order, and incorrectly returns an IO error for an open unset event instead of waiting.

name: waitqueue
reason: The model takes an already computed queue length and returns it unchanged, omitting t.cond and the waitqueue call, so the proposition is only an identity on a bare result variable.

name: wait
reason: The model omits the cancellation argument and check_cancel_arg call and directly applies its incomplete keyword _trywait model instead of forwarding to token wait.

name: wait
reason: The model replaces the token with a Boolean, inherits the nonblocking _trywait abstraction, uses an IO error for cancellation, and cannot represent the source cancellation check before the EOF branch.

name: isopen
reason: The proposition states the returned activity flag for every modeled event, but the model omits the source acquire atomic load.

name: close
reason: The model states the final closed and idempotent state but omits IO locking, the handle and activity branches, jl_close_uv, preservation, the completion wait loop, notification synchronization, and cleanup order.

name: uvfinalize
reason: The model states the final handle and activity invariants but omits IO and condition locking, disassociation, jl_close_uv, the distinct already-closed branch, notification, and cleanup order.

name: _uv_hook_close
reason: The model states the final cleared state but omits condition locking, capture and freeing of the old handle, atomic store order, notification, and finally-based unlocking.

name: uv_asynccb
reason: The model states that the event bit becomes set while other abstract fields remain unchanged but omits handle conversion, locking, the release store, notification, and finally-based unlocking.

name: uv_timercb
reason: The model leaves a closed unset timer unset although the source always sets it, derives one-shot status from a synthetic kind instead of uv_timer_get_repeat, and omits locking, notification, and close-call order.

name: sleep
reason: The model replaces the Real duration, cancellation argument, timer, wait, and finally close with two precomputed Booleans, so its proposition neither covers all inputs nor preserves actual cancellation and wait errors.

name: Timer
reason: The model incorrectly makes spawn=nothing always sticky and omits the callback, timeout, keyword arguments, current task, callback task and error path, lifetime operations, locking, and scheduling.

name: timedwait
reason: The model replaces the callback, Real timeout and poll interval, clock arithmetic, timer, polling loop, and close calls with precomputed validity, test results, and a poll count, so the proposition does not cover the method's allowed inputs or timing behavior.

name: TimeoutWait
reason: The model accepts only a Nat named timeoutMs and omits Float64 conversion from every Real value, so the proposition does not cover fractional, negative, infinite, or other allowed Real inputs.

name: wait_enqueue!
reason: The model states the preserved timeout, armed state, and true return but omits the WaitEntry, current task, timer construction, stored timer, spawned claimer and its exception and atomic-claim branches, thread-pool selection, and scheduling.

name: wait_dequeue!
reason: The model states the cleared timer state and preserved timeout but omits reading the stored timer, the nothing branch, closing a present timer, and the Unit return sequence.
